responsibility: Implements the registration and enablement mechanism for Go frontend debug dump categories used by `-fgo-dump-*` options. It maintains the global linked list of `Go_dump` descriptors and provides the C entry point that turns individual named dumps or `all` on for later checks by dump-producing code such as the AST dumper.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime registry for `-fgo-dump-*` options: it stores the global linked list of `Go_dump` descriptors and provides the C entry point that enables named dumps or `all`. Unlike go-dump.h, this file contains the registry state and option-handling logic.
